title: Situation Update: Customer Service — 214 calls, disconnections due Tuesday

fields.headline: 214 calls on paper; disconnection list due Tuesday; a closing needs a final bill
fields.narration: Customer Service has taken 214 calls since 09:00 on paper intake forms and the surge line is backed up. The weekly disconnection list for non-payment is scheduled to run Tuesday, and a title company needs a final water bill for a house closing on Wednesday.
keyFacts: Weekly disconnection list scheduled for Tuesday
A final bill is needed for a Wednesday closing
MBW-CIS-01 and the portal remain unavailable
fields.expectedAction: Customer Service suspends disconnections for non-payment, sets a manual final-bill process from the last read and asks the IC for more call takers; the PIO posts the Customer Service number and hours.
fields.facilitatorNote: Play the title company as polite but firm: the closing date will not move.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ransomware Riptide — Ransomware at City Hall and the Island Decision

instructorNote: The business side of a ransomware event lasts longer than the technical side. Watch for the disconnection hold.

snapshot.title: Verification Order — Final Confirmation Required

fields.headline: Final Verification Mandate Issued
fields.narration: Denise Albrecht, Director of Water Operations, stands at the head of the command table. 'This is not a review. This is a final verification order. All manual operations must be re-verified against the original setpoint limits in MDWS-SCADA-APP-A. The lab must re-run all grab samples from Zone 3. The SCADA / IT Security Manager must confirm that firewall rule FW-R-17 has been permanently disabled and that the jump host MBW-JUMP-01 is isolated and imaged for law enforcement. The Water Quality Manager must confirm no overfeed occurred and that all manual readings are within limits. The Public Information Officer must issue a 'Not Safe to Drink' advisory via MillbrookAlert, website, and social media. We are not lifting any advisory until every verification step is complete and documented.'
keyFacts: All manual grab samples re-verified against MDWS-SCADA-APP-A
Public advisory 'Not Safe to Drink' issued via all channels
fields.expectedAction: The Incident Commander (ops) issues the final verification order under ERP Section 4.3. The SCADA / IT Security Manager confirms that FW-R-17 has been permanently disabled and that MBW-JUMP-01 has been imaged and isolated. The Water Quality Manager (wq) confirms that all manual grab samples have been re-verified and that no overfeed has occurred. The Public Information Officer (pio) confirms that the 'Not Safe to Drink' advisory has been issued via MillbrookAlert, website, and social media.
fields.facilitatorNote: This inject confirms the final verification step. The team must now validate that all actions are complete before moving to advisory lifting.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject finalizes the verification chain. The team must confirm all actions are complete and documented before proceeding to advisory lifting. Watch for over-reliance on paper logs and failure to confirm digital dissemination of the advisory.
